_readme: One entry per Minecraft version. status: working = builds and has been run; planned = no code yet. Build with tools/Build-Version.ps1 -Version <key> [-Loader fabric|neoforge|forge|all]. The numbers are passed to Gradle as -P overrides, so gradle.properties never has to be edited.

26.2.note: Fabric: every Fabric API build for 26.2 fails at startup (fabric-resource-loader-v1 PackMixin does not match 26.2 Pack). NeoForge and Forge work.

1.21.x.note: Needs Mojang-mapped sources (Loom 'mojang()' or Yarn), ResourceLocation instead of Identifier, the old GUI/renderer APIs and dimension_type JSON without 'attributes'. Fabric API and YACL versions to be filled in per exact version.

1.16-1.18.note: Fabric API exists for 1.14+. Mixins and registries differ a lot.

1.8-1.13.note: Needs Legacy Fabric (not Fabric): its own loader, API and mappings, and no YACL or ModMenu. The monsters, blocks and places are data files and carry over; the Java side would be a rewrite per line.
